prompt: Generate one transparent animation sprite sheet for the existing female Constructor heroine. Reference 1 is her exact character design; reference 2 shows her current proportions and planted stance. Keep red braid, orange work jacket, purple scarf, dark trousers, brown boots, rectangular turquoise-and-white scrap-metal shield on her LEFT forearm and RED CROWBAR held in her RIGHT HAND. Detailed sharp post-apocalyptic comic ink with fine ivory cutout rim, same face and costume. Exactly SIXTEEN full-body sequential drawings in FOUR columns x FOUR rows, chronological row-major, uniform cells with generous TRANSPARENT gutters and margins. Fixed orthographic camera, facing right. All 16 figures same anatomical scale; no zoom. BOTH BOOTS and lower shins copied identically in every cell, same two horizontal positions and same baseline. Feet never step, slide, rotate, lift or change size; knees can flex above the fixed shins. Draw genuine changes of anatomy and occlusion, never rotate or distort an entire cutout. No ground, cast shadow, grid lines, text, VFX, extra people, duplicate limbs, cropped weapons or cropped feet. Keep every figure and all equipment wholly inside its own cell. Continuous motion with tiny consistent changes between neighboring frames, clear in-betweens. ACTION: POWERFUL CROWBAR SWING WITH COORDINATED BODY TURN, complete one-shot starts and ends in original low-shield guard. Frames1-3 ready then coil shoulders, ribcage and hips AWAY from the right-hand target, right elbow bends and draws RED CROWBAR back beside/behind her shoulder, shield close to left chest. Frames4-7 develop wind-up with clearly drawn 3D turning of jacket, waist, hips and shoulders. Frames8-10 unwind whole torso and hips toward RIGHT and SWING THE CROWBAR IN A STRONG HORIZONTAL ARC at an enemy in front of her; striking elbow extends, right hand follows the arc, face tracks target, shield arm counterbalances. Contact in frame9. Frames11-13 visible follow-through with torso turned and braid/scarf trailing. Frames14-16 smoothly recover original guard. Crucial: this must visibly be a ROTATIONAL BODY STRIKE with a hooked crowbar, not an arm-only straight poke, NOT a sword, not floating weapon. Both feet and lower shins NEVER change positions or orientation: rotation comes from hips/waist/upper body and flexing knees above fixed boots.
